title: Basic Sniper EA v1 - trend quality entry with reversal-signal exit
entry_long: 10-candle trend quality check: swing size > 1000 pips (min pip range) on gold = quality uptrend -> open buy
entry_short: mirror: 10-candle bearish trend quality check (New Bottom in trend) with swing >1000 pips -> open sell
exit: close buy/sell only when reversal signal fires: 100 pip move within 10 sec (Time Bomb) opposite direction, filtered by 1-min wait; no SL/TP set
buildon_idea: narrator states single fixed-lot version fails over a 5yr run; add martingale or custom-sequence lot escalation on loss with a capped consecutive-loss counter
novelty_note: trend-quality pre-filter (min swing size in pips over N candles) before entry is a reusable idea; exit is purely signal-based (no TP/SL orders)

title: Engulfing 3-candle pattern with fixed-dollar-risk cascading lot sizing
entry_long: 3 bearish candles (id4>id3>id2 body size descending) then id1 bullish engulfs id2's open -> buy, lot sized so SL loss ~= target USD risk
entry_short: mirror: 3 bullish candles descending in size then id1 bearish engulfs id2's open -> sell
exit: SL 15 pip / TP 30 pip (1:2 RR); optional account-wide cut-loss at -300 USD via boolean switch (off by default)
escalation_cap: none (optional -300 USD account cut-loss switch exists but is off by default; no consecutive-loss cap)
buildon_idea: add a hard consecutive-loss cap or default-enable the existing -300 USD cut-loss switch; flat-lot test the entry to confirm it has real edge before relying on the cascading position sizing
novelty_note: position size computed via fixed-dollar-risk-per-trade that accumulates prior loss + desired profit into the next stake = quasi-martingale money management rather than a fixed multiplier

title: Scouting pending-order breakout rev4 - adds breakeven-point lock-in
entry_long: buy-stop pending order placed 75pip above current price, opened only when ATR liquidity check (4-candle ATR rise >100pip) passes
entry_short: mirror: sell-stop pending order 75pip below current price under same ATR liquidity gate
exit: TP/SL 60pip; breakeven-point system: once profit reaches 30pip trigger, SL moves to breakeven+10pip lock-in
escalation_cap: consecutive-loss cap 10 (terminates EA); lot multiplier 1.2x on loss
buildon_idea: already capped by consecutive-loss=10 and has a breakeven lock; test replacing loss-count cap with an explicit max-lot ceiling as an additional safety layer
novelty_note: adds a breakeven-point trailing lock after a fixed pip trigger to rescue near-miss-TP trades that reverse; incremental revision within the recurring EX097 pending-order-breakout family

title: Scouting pending-order breakout rev1 - martingale capped + time filter
entry_long: buy-stop pending order 75pip above current price when no position/pending order exists, active only within server time 01:00-23:00
entry_short: mirror: sell-stop pending order 75pip below current price, same time filter
exit: target 50pip via floating-profit check (pip-as-position), close both sides and reset; SL 50pip on losing side triggers next-trade lot increase
buildon_idea: already capped at 10 consecutive losses; try linear-add or log-lot instead of x2 martingale to slow escalation, and test on additional symbol/TF pairs
novelty_note: adds a server-time filter restricting trading to 01:00-23:00; otherwise same breakout+martingale mechanism as the rest of the EX097 series

title: Scouting pending-order breakout v9 - optional ATR liquidity scalping toggle
indicators: ATR(Average True Range, period7, liquidity filter, optional)
entry_long: buy-stop pending order at price offset (300-500pip tested) from current price; if Scalping Mode=true opens every bar unfiltered, if false gated by ATR rising >100pip over 4 candles
entry_short: mirror sell-stop pending order at same offset under same optional ATR gate
exit: SL/TP symmetric (300pip example); on loss lot doubles (x2), on win resets to base 0.01 lot; consecutive-loss cap 10 terminates EA
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot volume ceiling plus consecutive-loss cap 10
buildon_idea: already has two safety caps (lot ceiling + loss-count); compare ATR-filter-always-on vs scalping-mode-on for drawdown, and try linear lot growth instead of x2
novelty_note: adds a runtime on/off toggle for whether the ATR liquidity filter gates entries, letting the same base strategy be compared filtered vs unfiltered

title: Scouting pending-order breakout original - ATR liquidity gate + martingale
entry_long: when 4-candle ATR shows >=100pip increase, place buy-stop pending order 75pip above price (base lot 0.05); opposite pending order deleted once one side triggers
entry_short: mirror sell-stop pending order 75pip below price under same ATR gate
exit: TP via profit-unrealized >60pip on both sides, reset on close; SL 60pip triggers next-trade lot x2
buildon_idea: already capped at 10 losses; try linear-add lot law instead of x2 martingale and re-test; the ATR liquidity gate is a reusable module worth testing on other symbols
novelty_note: core/original version of the recurring EX097 pending-order-breakout+martingale family that later revisions (rev1, rev2, rev4, v9) build on

title: Scouting pending-order breakout rev2 - ATR volatility-rise filter refinement
entry_long: buy-stop pending order 75pip above price (SL60pip), gated by Indicator-Rise block requiring ATR(period14) to be increasing, added on top of base breakout+martingale logic
entry_short: mirror sell-stop pending order 75pip below price under same ATR-rising gate
exit: TP via profit-unrealized 60pip (pip basis); SL60pip triggers lot x2 next trade; consecutive-loss cap 10 terminates EA
buildon_idea: already capped; author explicitly compares filtered-vs-unfiltered trade count/drawdown showing the ATR gate lowers frequency and risk - worth testing a daily-loss-percent cap variant (author suggests prop-firm/FTMO-style use) instead of only consecutive-loss count
novelty_note: video explicitly shows a before/after comparison of adding the ATR volatility-rise filter, and suggests applicability to funded-account challenges

title: 3-candle engulfing pattern with SMA-cross grid martingale recovery
entry_long: id3 bullish, id2 bearish (min body 100pip for id1/id3), id2-close above id3-open AND id1-close above id2-open (engulfing pattern) -> buy fixed 0.1 lot
entry_short: mirror: id3 bearish, id2 bullish, id2-close below id3-open AND id1-close below id2-open -> sell fixed 0.1 lot
exit: TP 50pip on floating profit, no initial SL; on adverse move, grid-add re-entry every 50pip distance gated by SMA8/SMA18 cross confirming reversal, lot +0.05 per grid step, capped at Max Order 20 per side
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders/side with linear +0.05 lot growth (not pure martingale) - good build-on candidate; add a hard SL/equity-stop since base entries currently carry none
novelty_note: grid re-entries are gated by an SMA-cross reversal-confirmation signal rather than pure price distance, reducing chase-into-trend risk versus plain martingale grids

title: 3-candle pullback pattern with balance-tiered auto lot sizing via custom code
entry_long: id4,id3,id2 bullish trend candles (min body 4pip) then id1 pulls back bearish but closes above id2's open -> buy
entry_short: mirror: id4,id3,id2 bearish trend candles then id1 pulls back bullish but closes below id2's open -> sell
exit: TP 30pip, no SL; on adverse move, grid-add re-entry every 40pip distance gated by a 3-candle reversal confirmation pattern; close all when floating profit > 10 USD
escalation_cap: none stated for number of grid-add steps
buildon_idea: add an explicit max-grid-step cap (none stated) and a hard SL; the balance-tiered lot-sizing custom-code snippet (lot scales with account_balance/initial_deposit ratio) is a reusable module worth extracting independent of this entry signal
novelty_note: demonstrates a simple custom-mql-code formula scaling lot size proportional to current account balance vs a reference deposit (e.g. 0.1 lot per 1000 USD) - a generic sizing building block

title: CCI overbought/oversold with signal-persistence count and dual-mode grid
entry_long: CCI(id1) < -100 sustained for >=5 consecutive candles (signal counter), then CCI crosses back above -100 -> buy 0.01 lot
entry_short: mirror: CCI(id1) > 100 sustained for >=5 consecutive candles, then CCI crosses back below 100 -> sell 0.01 lot
exit: TP via profit-in-pips (close_pip=8, pip-as-position basis); winning side pyramids same-direction fixed-lot trades every 30pip grid step (snowball/forward mode); losing side grid-recovers with lot+0.01 increment every 30pip (reverse mode), both capped at Max Order 20 per side
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders per side; pyramiding (winning) side shares the same cap as the recovery (losing) side - consider splitting caps and adding a portfolio-level equity stop; the signal-persistence counter (require N consecutive bars beyond threshold before triggering) is an extractable module
novelty_note: combines a signal-persistence counter (N-bar confirmation before oscillator crossback entry) with a two-mode grid that pyramids winners AND recovers losers simultaneously - an unusually dual-purpose grid design

title: Basic Moving Average strategy rev1 - adds trailing-stop snowball mode atop grid recovery
entry_long: price below EMA50 by >20pip AND EMA3 crosses above EMA8 -> buy 0.15 lot (only one side open at a time)
entry_short: mirror: price above EMA50 by >20pip AND EMA3 crosses below EMA8 -> sell 0.15 lot
exit: no fixed SL/TP on entry; two parallel post-entry modes: (1) forward/snowball - if trade is in profit, pyramid same-direction fixed-lot(0.15) trades every 10pip grid step with a trailing stop (15pip, 3pip step) across the group; (2) reverse/recovery - if adverse, grid-add every 10pip gated by bullish/bearish engulfing confirmation, lot+0.01 per step, capped Max Order=20, close all at pip_total_sum>8pip profit
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders; the profit-side snowball+trailing-stop addition is a good reusable module worth extracting as a standalone position-management add-on for other grid EAs
novelty_note: video explicitly shows a before/after comparison of adding a profit-side snowball+trailing-stop system to the existing grid-recovery EA (trade count rose from ~500 to ~800 with similar max DD)

title: Basic Moving Average strategy original - EMA50 distance filter + EMA cross with engulfing grid recovery
entry_long: price below EMA50 by >20pip AND EMA3 crosses above EMA8 -> buy 0.15 lot
entry_short: mirror: price above EMA50 by >20pip AND EMA3 crosses below EMA8 -> sell 0.15 lot
exit: close on profit>8pip (pip_total_sum); on adverse move, grid-add every 10pip gated by bullish/bearish engulfing confirmation, lot+0.01 per step, capped Max Order=20; optional equity-based cut-loss at -25% equity (switch off by default)
escalation_cap: Max Order = 20 per side; optional -25% equity cut-loss (default off)
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders with linear lot growth; default-enable the existing -25% equity cut-loss switch and test tighter caps; reported 76.5% win rate over a 5.5yr backtest makes this a strong build-on base
novelty_note: base/original version of the EX101 series; rev1 (39QTz76W5Ng) extends this with a profit-side snowball+trailing-stop system
